title: Mitchell Parker Rookie RC 2024 Topps Update #US5 Halloween Holiday Parallel
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Mitchell Parker Rookie RC 2024 Topps Update #US5 Halloween Holiday Parallel is a must-have for any Washington Nationals fan or baseball card collector. Made of high-quality card stock with a thickness of 35 Pt., this original sports trading card features the young player in a Major League Baseball (MLB) league setting.

The card is part of the 2024 Topps set and is a parallel variety, making it a unique addition to any collection. It is in English language and has not been autographed. The card's holiday parallel variety adds to its charm and makes it a great addition to any collection.
